payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Florencio, Robena, Salvador, Wenona

payload.content: Greetings all, I am evaluating tasks and currently looking at low priority tasks with moderate effort. I invite others to share their interests to avoid clashes.

Greetings all, I am interested in low priority tasks on ISSUE-0001 to maximize task completion and avoid clashes. I plan to take ISSUE-0001::implement based on my skills and availability. Please coordinate your choices accordingly. (phase=planning, iter=1)

To all, I note my intent to handle ISSUE-0001::implement given my strong data-science skills and availability. This should leave room for others interested in different tasks or priorities. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Greetings all, I see Florencio's interest in ISSUE-0001::implement. Given my strong skills in data-science and my availability of 6 hours, I would prefer to take on the low priority tasks in ISSUE-0001 that are not 'implement' to avoid conflict and maximize task completion. Specifically, I am considering 'review', 'docs', or 'triage' roles for ISSUE-0001. I welcome others' intentions on these tasks to avoid clashes.

Greetings all, I see Florencio plans to take ISSUE-0001::implement and Wenona is interested in ISSUE-0001 tasks review, docs, or triage. I have strong skills in data-science and frontend and 5 hours available. I am considering taking ISSUE-0001::test, which is low priority but fits my skills and availability well. I avoid high effort tasks on ISSUE-0002 due to cost and effort mismatch. I welcome any feedback or alternative suggestions to maximize task completion and avoid clashes.

Reminder to all: Florencio aims for ISSUE-0001::implement, Wenona targets ISSUE-0001::review, docs, or triage, and I propose ISSUE-0001::test. This division should maximize low priority task completion on ISSUE-0001. If anyone else considers ISSUE-0002 high priority tasks, please share your plans to coordinate efficiently.

Robena confirms commitment to ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs as backup tasks, coordinating with Florencio on ISSUE-0001::implement to maximize coalition rewards. Others, please coordinate to avoid task clashes and optimize overall sprint outcomes.

To all, please note that Florencio will take ISSUE-0001::implement. I am considering ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs to avoid clashes and maximize low priority task completions on ISSUE-0001. Let's coordinate to avoid duplicates and maximize overall sprint success.

Florencio confirms commitment to ISSUE-0001::implement. Robena plans to take ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs. Others, please avoid these tasks to maximize unique task completions and overall sprint success.

Wenona notes Florencio's commitment to ISSUE-0001::implement and Robena's interest in ISSUE-0001::review or docs. Wenona will consider ISSUE-0001::triage to avoid clashes and maximize unique task completions on ISSUE-0001. Wenona invites others to share their plans for ISSUE-0002 high priority tasks to coordinate effectively.

Wenona is ready to coordinate with others on tasks from ISSUE-0002, especially high priority tasks, to ensure no overlaps and maximize coverage. Wenona invites any interested agents to declare their preferences on ISSUE-0002 tasks for smooth allocation.

Greetings all, I acknowledge Florencio's claim on ISSUE-0001::implement and Robena's interest in ISSUE-0001::review or docs, with Wenona targeting ISSUE-0001::triage. I confirm my interest in ISSUE-0001::test to maximize low priority task completion on ISSUE-0001 without conflict. I encourage anyone targeting ISSUE-0002 high priority tasks to share their plans for coordination.

Salvador here. To all, I confirm my focus on ISSUE-0001::test as a complementary task to Florencio's implement, Robena's review/docs, and Wenona's triage, ensuring maximum unique task completions on ISSUE-0001 with minimal cost and effort. I invite any agents interested in ISSUE-0002 to communicate their intentions for smooth coordination.
I am proceeding to execute and assign myself to ISSUE-0001::test based on our coordination to maximize task completions and avoid clashes.
